Project: MuJoCo Menagerie / Franka Research 3
Upstream: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie
Copied from: LfD_sim/vendor/mujoco_menagerie/franka_fr3/
Source checkout: 63e07b4f22240790818a0d884cb634e3b2a90054 (local changes recorded in asset_manifest.json)

Included: fr3.xml, its 36 referenced meshes, and LICENSE.
The copied files are byte-identical to the source checkout. No XML or mesh
parameters were changed. The model uses the attachment_site TCP.

Revision discrepancy in the source: common/robots.py labels Menagerie as
cda5236f98383f6fbaa4820c6b18dba892cd087f, while common/VENDORED.txt says the
FR3 files match d7b481b. This migration has not independently resolved the
upstream revision. The exact copied-file hashes are in asset_manifest.json.

License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.

Local fixed-joint variants (2026-11-16):
fr3_fixed_j5.xml: J5 removed; fr3_fixed_j3.xml: J3 removed;
fr3_fixed_j3_j5.xml: J3 and J5 removed. All use the same assets/ directory.
For each removed joint the fixed angle is (lower + upper)/2 from fr3.xml:
J3: (-2.9007 + 2.9007)/2 = 0 rad; J5: (-2.8763 + 2.8763)/2 = 0 rad.
At zero angle the existing body-to-parent transform is already the fixed
transform; it is retained verbatim, as are all bodies, inertials, geoms and TCP.
Only the named joint and its actuator are removed; qpos/ctrl keyframe entries
are filtered in original joint order. No equality constraints or soft locks.
Original fr3.xml and shared meshes remain byte-identical to the source.

Additional local variants (2026-11-17):
fr3_fixed_j3_j7.xml: J3, J7 fixed (5 DoF; J1,J2,J4,J5,J6 free).
fr3_fixed_j3_j5_j7.xml: J3, J5, J7 fixed (4 DoF; J1,J2,J4,J6 free).
fr3_fixed_j3_j5_j6_j7.xml: J3, J5, J6, J7 fixed (3 DoF; J1,J2,J4 free).
J7 midpoint = 0 rad; J6 midpoint = (0.4398 + 4.6216)/2 = 2.5307 rad.
The nonzero J6 lock is baked into fr3_link6's body-to-parent transform:
R_fixed = R_body * R_axis(midpoint - ref), with the corresponding translation
about the joint anchor. Joint and actuator elements are removed, keyframe
qpos/ctrl filtered. Link inertials, geometry, hierarchy and TCP are retained.

Additional local variants (2026-11-23):
fr3_fixed_j1.xml, fr3_fixed_j2.xml, fr3_fixed_j4.xml, fr3_fixed_j6.xml and
fr3_fixed_j7.xml each fix one joint (6 DoF).
fr3_fixed_j1_j3.xml, fr3_fixed_j2_j3.xml and fr3_fixed_j1_j5.xml each fix
two joints (5 DoF). fr3_fixed_j5_j6_j7.xml fixes three joints (4 DoF).
J4 midpoint = (-3.077 - 0.1169)/2 = -1.59695 rad. Like the J6 lock at
2.5307 rad, it is baked into the corresponding link's local transform.
The J1, J2, J3, J5 and J7 locks have zero midpoint angles.

Independent full-7-DoF density variants:
fr3_link3_mass_150pct.xml / fr3_link3_mass_200pct.xml scale ONLY fr3_link3's
inertial mass and all three principal inertias by 1.5 / 2.0.
fr3_link7_mass_150pct.xml / fr3_link7_mass_200pct.xml do the same for fr3_link7.
COM pos/quat, all other links, joint ranges, actuators and keyframes are unchanged.
All variants share the original assets/ directory.
The local tools.generate_fr3_variants module generates the variants registered in
sim/fr3_variants.py. Run it with --check to compare the generated and saved XMLs.
